text: Petrochemical Industries Development Management Company (PIDMCO) is a wholly owned subsidiary of PGPIC: 100% owned by PGPIC per company information, and the US Treasury's 7 June 2019 action designates PIDMCO among PGPIC's Iran-based subsidiary petrochemical companies for being owned or controlled by PGPIC.
short: PIDMCO is a wholly owned PGPIC subsidiary.

source.name: Hormuz Group: Petrochemical Industries Development Management Company — company profile
source.quote: 100% owned by Persian Gulf Petrochemical Industries Company (PGPIC), according to PGPIC information current as of 2023
